programme.title: Sevanthi
programme.desc: Sevanthi is daily family entertainment serial in Udaya TV. Arjun and Anuradha both are grandchildren of Pramoda Devi. The family is wanting the duo to get hitched and their closeness has generated such emotion in the hearts of family members. However, because of tragedy befell on family of Anuradha, She end up growing as Sevanthi at an Ashram (orphanage) run by Shantamurthy. The Ashram one day lands in trouble as Sakshi, hailing from an elite family conspires to take over. To safeguard the ashram, Sevanthi approaches Arjun. The popular advocate Arjun put pre-condition of contractual marriage with her, only if Sevanthi agrees to that, he says, he will protect the Ashram. What would happen if a boy who has no belief in relationship and love marries a girl who lives breathing love and care is the knot of the tale.

She senses Raj's friend Rohit is really her lost love, Babu, but, having never actually seen him, she can't be sure.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.
programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

Among the members of the group are firedog Marshall, police pup Chase, and fearless Skye. All of the animals have special skills, gadgets and vehicles that help them on their rescue missions. programme.desc: "Beyond the Screen" explores the art of filmmaking in an effort to enrich one's movie-watching experience. programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: A group of six rescue dogs, led by a tech-savvy boy named Ryder, has adventures in "PAW Patrol." The heroic pups, who believe "no job is too big, no pup is too small," work together to protect the community. Among the members of the group are firedog Marshall, police pup Chase, and fearless Skye. All of the animals have special skills, gadgets and vehicles that help them on their rescue missions. Whether rescuing a kitten or saving a train from a rockslide, the PAW Patrol is always up for the challenge while also making sure there's time for a game or a laugh.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Shaun the Sheep thinks and acts like a person in a barnyard, which usually gets him into trouble. The farmer's sheepdog, Bitzer, tries to keep Shaun and his friends out of trouble. The farmer is oblivious to the humanlike features of his flock, who are like one big, happy family.

credits.actor: John Sparkes,Justin Fletcher,Kate Harbour,Richard Webber,Jo Allen

programme.sub-title: Shaun, a remarkably intelligent sheep and leader of his flock at Mossy Bottom Farm, endeavours to inject some thrill into their monotonous routine while avoiding detection by the farmer.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.

programme.title: Shipping Wars
programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. The competition begins each day when thousands of shipments are put up for auction online, and the truckers who make the lowest bids get the loads. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

programme.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the "Pawn Stars" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny "The Count" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: It's not that Steve Backshall has a death wish. Quite the opposite, actually. He lives for adventure, and his mission to come as close as possible to 60 of the world's most deadly animals is a brazen way to challenge himself. The naturalist and wildlife expert journeys to five continents and encounters a wide range of mammals, birds, reptiles and insects -- some familiar, others quite unusual -- including Baja rattlesnakes, tarantula hawk wasps, Humboldt squid, wolf eels and flesh-eating cockroaches. Backshall also tries to mimic the animals to see if he can match their lethal skills, such as hanging like a bat or flying down a zip wire to emulate a fish eagle.
programme.sub-title: In the medieval Ethiopian city of Harar, Steve Backshall has a unique and potentially lethal encounter with a pack of spotted hyenas.

He lives for adventure, and his mission to come as close as possible to 60 of the world's most deadly animals is a brazen way to challenge himself. The naturalist and wildlife expert journeys to five continents and encounters a wide range of mammals, birds, reptiles and insects -- some familiar, others quite unusual -- including Baja rattlesnakes, tarantula hawk wasps, Humboldt squid, wolf eels and flesh-eating cockroaches. Backshall also tries to mimic the animals to see if he can match their lethal skills, such as hanging like a bat or flying down a zip wire to emulate a fish eagle.
programme.sub-title: Steve and the crew head into the beautiful Alaskan wilderness for another deadly adventure. It is the largest state in America which inhabits some of the most impressive predators on Earth.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: The planet is teeming with myriad life forms, both plant and animal, all interlocked in a struggle for survival. As time goes on, some living things are forced to adapt and change to survive. This series chronicles some of the most unusual, if not downright bizarre, behaviors that living organisms have devised to keep their species alive. The 11-episode series was four years in the making, taking camera crews to every continent and habitat.
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on how from the Equator to the Poles, birds find the most ingenious ways to overcome the challenges of life.

programme.title: Earth's Natural Wonders: Living on the Edge
programme.desc: Combining stunning photography, cinematography and compelling human drama, this documentary series uncovers the stories of people fighting to survive -- and even triumph -- in Earth's natural wonders. Filmed on six continents in 12 languages, viewers are transported to some of Earth's most extraordinary places, from Mount Everest and the Grand Canyon to the Amazon rain forest and Zambia's Victoria Falls. Stories feature wonders created by the power of water, and a young Sherpa who ropes across Mount Everest's Khumbu Icefall.
programme.sub-title: Dive into stories of wonders shaped by water's awesome, unpredictable power. Also, discover how these places push their inhabitants to the limit.

programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

programme.desc: Mordecai, a blue jay, and Rigby, a raccoon, are groundskeepers at a park, but these best friends are lazy and don't let their jobs interfere with their ability to have fun. While Mordecai tries to be responsible and do a good job, he's frequently led astray by his immature pal, who is totally without fear or shame. The friends often end up having to pay for their irresponsible actions as they usually get into more trouble than they anticipated. Their slacking off at work causes much chagrin for their hot-tempered gumball machine boss, Benson.

programme.desc: With Majin Buu now defeated and Earth at peace, the heroes have settled into normal lives, which in Goku's case means being a radish farmer. They can't get too comfortable in their new lives because more evildoers are on the horizon. Enter Beerus, the powerful god of destruction, who awakens -- far away from Earth -- to a prophecy predicting his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. His search for that being brings him to Earth, where he enters a battle against Goku and his friends. In order to save the world -- again -- they must defeat Beerus, their strongest opponent yet.

programme.sub-title: There is little room for mistakes when we enter into the wild world of animals. Tourist Ria Cilliers and her husband find themselves sharing their morning coffee with a leopard.

programme.title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: Across the planet, wolves and lions lead two legendary predator lineages: canids and felines. We explore their differences and similarities, from brute strength to social intelligence, revealing who dominates in each territory.
programme.sub-title: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young.

programme.title: The Leopardess
programme.desc: Follow a female leopard in the forests of the Serengeti River, raising her growing family.
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its labyrinth of gallery forests are the home of a leopardess. To her family she is both caring provider and fearless defender. For her prey she is sudden death, for her son the only chance to survive in this unforgiving wilderness.

programme.title: Deadliest South Africa
programme.desc: Kurdt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the life of lions, their survival instincts and their habit of protecting their pride from other animals.
programme.sub-title: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions' camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Arabian Inferno
programme.desc: The scorching sun has turned the Arabian landscape into a burning desert.
programme.sub-title: The Arabian Desert is one of the most challenging places on earth, but the animals here are resilient and specialised. Even for the hardiest inhabitants, death's never far away. Creatures must seize every opportunity to find food, shelter and water. Adaptability is the key to dune survival.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: The filmmaker travels across the globe to document some of the strongest animals living on vast landscapes who have endured the rigors of nature.
programme.sub-title: Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme. From the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on how animals in the wild are equipped with natural weapons to attack, defend and hunt thus ensuring their survival.
programme.sub-title: The electric catfish and electric ray use shocks to attack their victims, while elephants and kangaroos fight with their feet.

programme.title: Wild Assassins
programme.desc: The presenters explore various techniques wild animals use to hunt their prey in order to survive. Some of these techniques include venom, camouflage, and expertise in hiding.
programme.sub-title: Explores how the most venomous creatures, including Sydney Funnel Web spider and the Diamondback rattlesnake, hunt their preys and survive in the wild.

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.desc: Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Super
programme.desc: With Majin Buu now defeated and Earth at peace, the heroes have settled into normal lives, which in Goku's case means being a radish farmer. They can't get too comfortable in their new lives because more evildoers are on the horizon. Enter Beerus, the powerful god of destruction, who awakens -- far away from Earth -- to a prophecy predicting his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. His search for that being brings him to Earth, where he enters a battle against Goku and his friends. In order to save the world -- again -- they must defeat Beerus, their strongest opponent yet.

As part of the inheritance, her father has left hertwo portraits of a beautiful woman from his collection of paintings.RUJA wants to sell the paintings so that she can afford the medical surgery that her daughter RACHEL (Nina- Nutthacha) needs to treat a serious vision problem. But cracks have started to form in the portraits. This leads her to meet TIM (Nichkhun), an art restorer. Without knowing the price they must pay for art, Tim and Ruja investigate further into the paintings and more mystery unfolds.

programme.desc: A showcase of some of wildlife's most remarkable moments, caught on film by amateurs and professionals. We reveal the full spectrum of animal behaviour: the brutal, the beautiful and the bizarre. Each moment is explained by experts in the field.
programme.sub-title: Odd encounters in the wild are unpredictable at best and deadly at worst. Discover what happens to Ria Cilliers and her husband, who end up having their morning coffee with a leopard.

programme.title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: Across the planet, wolves and lions lead two legendary predator lineages: canids and felines. We explore their differences and similarities, from brute strength to social intelligence, revealing who dominates in each territory.
programme.sub-title: Across the planet, wolves and lions lead two legendary predator lineages: canids and felines. We explore their differences and similarities, from brute strength to social intelligence, revealing who dominates in each territory.

programme.title: The Leopardess
programme.desc: Follow a female leopard in the forests of the Serengeti River, raising her growing family.
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its dangerous forests are home to a mother leopardess who is both a caring provider and a fearless defender of her family.

programme.title: Deadliest South Africa
programme.desc: Kurdt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the life of lions, their survival instincts and their habit of protecting their pride from other animals.
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into a pride of lions within the Serengeti National Park, in northern Tanzania, playing hide and seek to sharpen their instincts.

programme.title: Arabian Inferno
programme.desc: The scorching sun has turned the Arabian landscape into a burning desert.
programme.sub-title: The Arabian Desert might be one of the most challenging places on earth, but the animals here are resilient and specialised.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: The filmmaker travels across the globe to document some of the strongest animals living on vast landscapes who have endured the rigors of nature.
programme.sub-title: There are many stoic creatures that survive in the unforgiving sands of arid deserts like elephants, the Namaqua chameleon and the shovel-snouted lizard.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on how animals in the wild are equipped with natural weapons to attack, defend and hunt thus ensuring their survival.
programme.sub-title: Animals use various techniques to win a vicious brawl. While Bighorn Sheep establish mating rights by smashing their heads together, a Silverback Gorilla wrestles with the strength of 20 adult men.

programme.title: Wild Assassins
programme.desc: The presenters explore various techniques wild animals use to hunt their prey in order to survive. Some of these techniques include venom, camouflage, and expertise in hiding.
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on some of the most dangerous animals and the deadly weapons they use in order to survive in the wild.

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.desc: Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.
programme.sub-title: It has been a year since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride gave birth to their cubs. Now, they must hunt without the support of the rest of the family, with hyenas hot on their heels.

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.
